items.title: Japan probe sets course for Mars moon
items.description: The MMX spacecraft is on its way to Mars' moon Phobos to collect surface samples that could help answer long-standing questions about the formation of the Solar System.

items.title: North Sea strikes could severely disrupt UK fuel supplies, union warns
items.description: <p>More than ⁠160 ​offshore rig workers plan walkout amid rising tensions between unions and oil companies </p><p>North Sea workers are preparing to strike at oil rigs across the ageing basin over the coming weeks in a sign of growing tensions between trade unions and oil companies.</p><p>The Unite union said on ⁠Monday that more than ⁠160 ​offshore rig workers would take part ⁠in a 24-hour ​strike from Wednesday that could “severely disrupt” UK fuel supplies.</p

items.title: Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro tied ahead of runoff vote
